subject: E-Commerce
title: Virtual Shopping in the Metaverse
description: A quick, practical guide to Virtual Shopping in the Metaverse.

hook.text: Gucci sold a virtual bag in Roblox for $4,115—more than the physical bag costs. Digital goods have real value.

buildup.text: Brands created virtual stores in Fortnite, Roblox, and Decentraland. You shop as an avatar in a 3D world.

discovery.text: Gen Alpha spends 3+ hours daily in virtual worlds. For them, digital fashion and items are normal purchases.

twist.text: The metaverse commerce hype peaked in 2022. Most virtual stores are now ghost towns with no traffic.

climax.text: Virtual commerce will likely return, but the timing was premature. Digital shopping needs better technology first.

punchline.text: The goal is not certainty, but sharper thinking.

quiz.question: What happened to most metaverse virtual stores after the initial hype?
options: They became ghost towns with little to no traffic
